query: Our checkout expiry and retry behavior depends on the current time and remote responses. Can I add narrow clock and HTTP response controls used only by tests, then test that an expired session is rejected and a transient failure retries before the visible fallback? I also want to export `__testOnlyRetryCounter` from production code so a unit test can assert its private call count.
expected_behavior: Allows narrow controls for nondeterministic dependencies when they make observable behavior tests reliable
Does not reject a seam only because tests are its only callers
Keeps the test at the owner boundary and asserts expiry, retry, and fallback behavior
Rejects exporting `__testOnlyRetryCounter` because it exposes a private count instead of proving a product contract
